newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open up 0.30 to 0.40 cent.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open up 0.30 to 0.40 cent.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open 0.30 to 0.40 cent firmer Tuesday as LME stock dipped in line with most trader expectations.
LME briefly firmed Tuesday following a drop of 4,225 tonnes in stocks to 109,175 tonnes. LME was ranging in quiet trade this morning.
COMEX stocks Monday fell 276 short tons to 31,155 short tons.
On ACCESS, December copper last traded at 96.00 cents a lb, up 0.40 cent from Monday's close.
